name: Chaitén volcano
region: Pumalín Douglas Tompkins National Park, Los Lagos
why: Stairs through a forest killed by the 2008 eruption to the rim of the caldera, with the steaming dome inside and the sea behind.
book: Free; trail entry only until 14:00. The trailhead is at the Los Gigios bridge on the Carretera Austral, 34 km south of Caleta Gonzalo.
water: None on the trail: carry 1.5 litres.
dangers: Steep stairs and loose ash; slippery when wet.
No shade among the dead trees: sun and wind.
Volcanic gases near the dome: stay at the lookout.

points.name: Chaitén volcano trailhead
points.note: By the Los Gigios bridge on the Carretera Austral, with a small car park. The trail climbs at once on stairs.

points.name: Dead forest
points.note: Trees killed by the hot ash of 2008 still stand on the slope; the climb gets steeper above.

points.name: Chaitén crater lookout
points.note: On the caldera rim: the new lava dome steams inside, the town and the sea behind. Return the same way.
